remarks: Welcome to 77 Aspen Lane, a tranquil North Stamford retreat situated on a quiet, tree-lined cul-de-sac. This well-maintained home offers bright and comfortable living spaces with an easy flow, surrounded by nature and privacy. The main level features a spacious living room with abundant natural light, dining room, and renovated kitchen. Generously sized bedrooms and additional living spaces offer room for a home office, family room, or playroom. Outdoors, enjoy the peaceful setting with mature trees, and over an acre of flat yard space. Conveniently located near parks, hiking trails, schools, and Stamford's shopping and dining destinations, this home blends quiet suburban living with excellent access to local amenities.
